description: Road Transport Industry WHS Statistics is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Safe Work Australia. The Road Transport Industry WHS statistics include trends in workers' compensation claims, fatalities and other data broken down by jurisdiction and mechanism of injury or disease. It shows a breakdown of fatalities by victim activity at the time of fatality, type of vehicle involved, relationship to vehicle and type of road. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-06-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
